tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures include `sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation`; the instructions require abstention when this non-stationary oscillation is observed. The available initial rows do not justify fitting a stationary smooth law or spending on additional probes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature indicates non-stationary behavior, for which the permitted stationary smooth mechanisms are not an appropriate fit.
Barrier activation alone could motivate this model, but it cannot resolve the conflicting non-stationary oscillation signature.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the target law and should not be purchased.
